Solid-to-Gross Area Ratio (epsilon): [1] Design Wind Force Equation (Eq. 29.4-1): F = qz * Kd * G * Cf * Af (lb or N), where Af = projected area normal to the wind except where Cf is specified for the gross area, and Kd = 0.85 per Table 26.6-1.
[2] Notation: epsilon = ratio of solid area to gross area; D = diameter of a typical round member, in ft (m); qz = velocity pressure evaluated at height z above ground, in psf (N/m^2).
[3] Signs with openings comprising less than 30% of the gross area (epsilon > 0.70) shall be classified as solid signs and designed in accordance with Figure 29.3-1.
[4] Force coefficients for elements with both flat-sided and rounded members may be calculated using a weighted average by projected area of each member type.

[5] For multi-slat horizontal open trellises/pergolas, horizontal wind drag is evaluated per Figure 29.4-2 across projected beam/joist/post areas (incorporating multiple-frame shielding or sequential frame contribution), and vertical uplift/downforce on horizontal slats is checked using net pressure coefficients on solid slat area.
